tagline.en: Autoregressive video diffusion for fast, streaming generation — real-time-oriented text-to-video and image-to-video.
tagline.zh: 面向快速、流式生成的自回归视频扩散——偏实时的文生视频与图生视频。

en: Self-Forcing is an autoregressive video diffusion model designed for fast, streaming generation. It generates video frame by frame in a way aimed at real-time throughput, rather than rendering a whole clip in a single batched pass.

It supports both text-to-video and image-to-video, and is distributed with code and weights. It relies on local Wan2.1 weights under the expected layout, and the Self-Forcing checkpoint (self_forcing_dmd.pt) on top.

In WorldFoundry, Self-Forcing runs the vendored official inference path — supply a prompt (and an image for image-to-video), and it produces a video. Checkpoint paths default to the standard layout and can be overridden if staged elsewhere.
zh: Self-Forcing 是一个面向快速、流式生成的自回归视频扩散模型。它逐帧生成视频,目标是实时吞吐,而不是一次性批量渲染整段片段。
它同时支持文生视频与图生视频,并以代码加权重的形式发布。它依赖按预期布局放置的本地 Wan2.1 权重,并在其上加载 Self-Forcing checkpoint(self_forcing_dmd.pt)。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Self-Forcing 运行内置的官方推理路径——给出提示词(图生视频再加一张图),它就产出视频。checkpoint 路径默认使用标准布局,如放在别处可覆盖设置。

whenToUse.en: Use Self-Forcing when you want fast, streaming-style video generation from text or an image, including experiments toward real-time output.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从文本或图片做快速、流式风格的视频生成(包括面向实时输出的实验)时,可以使用 Self-Forcing。

notFor.en: It needs local Wan2.1 weights staged in a compatible layout alongside its own checkpoint — set those up before a run.
notFor.zh: 它需要在自有 checkpoint 之外,按兼容布局准备本地 Wan2.1 权重——运行前请先配置好。

en: Autoregressive video diffusion for streaming, real-time-oriented generation
Builds on local Wan2.1 weights plus the Self-Forcing checkpoint
zh: 面向流式、偏实时生成的自回归视频扩散
以代码加权重形式发布
在本地 Wan2.1 权重之上加载 Self-Forcing checkpoint
